pages.text: The $(item)Portable Banker$() has a $(l)MARKET$() key under the Shopping Network. The market is its own one-time unlock: $(l)UNLOCK MARKET$() takes 12 Netherite Shatter Coins from your inventory, and it stays with your account on every server.

MARKET opens the same market as a Trade Post: browse, buy, list lots and collect, wherever you are.$(br2)There is no list of traders on the Portable Banker. Trading with another player needs a Trade Post, and nobody can ask you to trade while you are only on the banker.$(br2)The unlock lasts the season, like the Shopping Network.
